notes: New: in-panel notifications. A bell icon next to the account avatar (top-right) now shows a live feed of the same events already wired to Telegram personal alerts - new service added, service changed and needs translation, new content needs translation, and a post about to send to the channel - plus a new event: translation completed (service, category, and blog translation each summarize their own run). Notifications only ever show to admins who actually have access to the relevant section (Telegram-channel notifications need Telegram access, translation notifications need Translation access), and each admin can mark a whole category as read independently - one admin's read state never affects another's. Requires 'Update database' after installing this update (adds two new tables).
